friends.doc: The friends list (Docs/features/15-social.md §2.1). The milestone lists are parallel: one entry a milestone; their length IS the reward path.

max.doc: How many friends a player may have.

maxSent.doc: How many friend requests a player may have waiting for an answer at once.

countsFromTownhall.doc: The Townhall level a friend must have reached to count toward the rewards.

suggestions.doc: How many suggested kingdoms the requests panel offers.

milestones.doc: Friends who count, for each reward on the path, rising.

items.doc: An item each milestone puts in the Bag, or empty for none.
